criteria.text: Patient is being treated for cutaneous lesions with Kaposi’s sarcoma (approval criterion 1).
Patient is not being treated systemically for Kaposi’s sarcoma (approval criterion 2).

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Panretin (alitretinoin), gel: 60 gram. Indicated for topical treatment of cutaneous lesions in patients with AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma.
Source is OCR-recovered from scanned 200908_panretin.pdf, Version 1, last updated 06/04/2009. The effective_date stub 2009-01-01 is retained; it is not a verified policy effective date.

Not indicated when systemic anti-KS therapy is required, e.g., more than 10 new KS lesions in the prior month, symptomatic lymphedema, symptomatic pulmonary KS, or symptomatic visceral involvement. These limitations remain notes for manual review.
There is no experience to date using Panretin gel with systemic anti-KS treatment.
Authorization (notes only): coverage may be approved for up to 2 months.
Remains partial: clinical evidence, systemic treatment need and authorization duration require manual review. No quantity limit is stated; max_units is null. PDL status unknown.
